title: How Robust is Your Fairness? Evaluating and Sustaining Fairness under Unseen Distribution Shifts
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study. The key findings relate to the proposed CUMA method, which achieves more robust fairness under distribution shifts for non-religious sensitive attributes compared to existing methods, without sacrificing overall accuracy or in-distribution fairness.

measurement_description: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The study focused on evaluating and sustaining fairness (measured by Equalized Odds) in machine learning models under unseen distribution shifts, using sensitive attributes like sex, race, and physical appearance.
